last_post_text:
Rage is an easy sanctuary; it asks only that you burn. But to break a cycle of ruin, you must learn to carry your ash without setting fire to the future. We are not bound by the gods who made us, nor the blood on our hands, but by the courage to be better than the monsters of our past.
